title: Missing Security Headers - Multiple Header Vulnerabilities
description: The application is missing critical security headers across all HTTP responses. The application does not implement X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers. This exposes the application to multiple attack vectors including clickjacking, MIME-type confusion attacks, content injection, and SSL stripping attacks. Security headers are fundamental defense-in-depth mechanisms that browsers use to prevent various client-side attacks.
impact: Applications without proper security headers are vulnerable to: 1) Clickjacking attacks - users tricked into clicking hidden elements on top of legitimate content; 2) MIME-type confusion attacks - JavaScript files served as text/plain could be executed; 3) Content injection attacks - CSS/JavaScript injected through various means without CSP restrictions; 4) SSL stripping attacks - in non-HTTPS environments; 5) Referrer information leakage - sensitive URLs exposed to third-party sites. This significantly increases the attack surface and reduces the browser's built-in defense mechanisms.
evidence:
POC Execution Output:
- Target: http://localhost:5000
- Endpoints tested: / and /addbook
- Security headers checked: 14 critical headers
- Results: 14 missing headers, 0 present headers

Specific missing headers verified:
✗ X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking protection)
✗ X-XSS-Protection (Legacy XSS protection for older browsers)
✗ X-Content-Type-Options (MIME-sniffing prevention)
✗ Content-Security-Policy (CSP - prevents inline script execution)
✗ Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS - enforces HTTPS)
✗ Referrer-Policy (Controls referrer information leakage)
✗ Permissions-Policy (Restricts dangerous browser APIs)

HTTP Response Headers (raw):
- connection: close
- content-length: 978
- content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
- date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 16:00:28 GMT
- server: Werkzeug/3.1.4 Python/3.9.25

All tested endpoints returned 200 OK but without any security headers.
remediation:
1. Implement X-Frame-Options header: Set to "DENY" to prevent clickjacking, or "SAMEORIGIN" if framing is needed for same-origin sites only
2. Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to prevent MIME-type sniffing attacks
3. Implement a strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header: Start with "default-src 'self'" and gradually expand as needed
4. Set Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) for HTTPS environments: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload
5. Add Referrer-Policy header: Set to "no-referrer" or "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" to limit referrer leakage
6. Add Permissions-Policy header to restrict dangerous APIs like camera, microphone, geolocation
7. For Flask applications: Use flask-talisman middleware to automatically add these headers:
   - Install: pip install flask-talisman
   - Usage: from flask_talisman import Talisman; Talisman(app, force_https=True, strict_transport_security=True, content_security_policy={'default-src': "'self'"})
8. Test the implementation using: curl -i http://localhost:5000/ and verify all headers are present
references: OWASP A01:2021 - Broken Access Control, OWASP Missing Security Headers, CWE-693 - Protection Mechanism Failure, OWASP Top 10 2021 Security Misconfiguration, NIST SP 800-52 Rev. 2
toolCallDescription: Document the missing security headers vulnerability with working POC proof
